title: Restore canonical drawing detail without geometric invention

needs: Restore soft pencil-like drawing marks locally for large-format print without thickening noise or inventing missing geography.
Separate parchment, continuous grayscale ink, protected text, and structural illustration before enhancement.
Verify every written name against web research and authoritative published references before final rendering.
context: The 12k master is geometrically authoritative and must not be resized during restoration.
The current alpha-only refinement can strengthen weak marks but cannot reconstruct missing source information safely.

Web verification must record exact spelling, source URL, source type, and verification status for every final label; reference sources include the Gwendalavir places index and published/book-derived references.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: The pipeline creates separate parchment, continuous grayscale ink, text-protection, and structural-detail layers from the 12k master without altering its coordinate system.
AC2: Per-block sharpness heatmaps quantify Laplacian variance, contour width, local contrast, and ink density for 256–512 px regions.

AC3: Only regions flagged as soft receive local candidate restoration; each candidate is rejected when it exceeds 20% stroke-width growth, loses fine components, adds halos, alters contours, or changes letters.
AC4: Text areas receive only conservative deconvolution, contrast, and halo cleanup; no skeletonization, vectorization, generative pixels, or guessed spelling is allowed.
AC5: Existing mountains, trees, cliffs, waves, coasts, rivers, and symbols are structure-preserved; optional detail is permitted only in the parchment background as near-invisible print-scale grain.
AC6: A QA contact sheet covers 15–30 representative regions with original, current 12k, restored, and amplified difference views, alongside provenance and web-label verification evidence.

product.title: Structure-Preserving Drawing Restoration
product.overview: A local, quantitative restoration pipeline for improving print-scale readability while treating the 12k map as immutable geometry.
goals: Recover readability without uniform black-line conversion.
Protect authoritative labels through web-backed spelling verification.
Keep restoration reversible, local, and inspectable.
non_goals: Global sharpening or threshold-only line replacement.
Replacing the current first-draft and refined outputs.

backlog_items.title: Build layered restoration inputs and web-verified label registry
problem: Ink, paper, and text need independent treatment.
scope_in: Continuous ink extraction, parchment separation, text protection masks, and web-source label registry.
acceptance_criteria: AC1.1: Layers share the 12k coordinate system.
AC4.1: Every label records exact spelling and web/published-source verification.

backlog_items.title: Implement local blur diagnostics and restoration candidate selection
problem: Only genuinely soft blocks should be changed.
scope_in: Block metrics, heatmaps, weak-PSF Richardson-Lucy candidates, and automatic quality rejection.
acceptance_criteria: AC2.1: Heatmaps record all four specified metrics.
AC3.1: Candidate acceptance enforces all quantitative guardrails.

backlog_items.title: Preserve illustrated structures and add print-scale paper grain
problem: Illustrated structures must remain canonical while the paper may receive subtle finishing.
scope_in: Structure-preserving filtering and optional 0.1–0.3 mm background-only grain.
scope_out: New mountains, trees, rivers, symbols, or decorative map information.
acceptance_criteria: AC5.1: All optional grain is background-only and nearly invisible in global view.

backlog_items.title: Generate QA sheet and print-safe restoration exports
problem: Approval requires visual and numeric evidence across representative regions.
scope_in: 15–30 region QA sheet, amplified differences, manifests, and PNG/TIFF/JPEG/HEIC exports.
acceptance_criteria: AC6.1: QA output is reviewable before any print candidate is selected.

orchestration_task.title: Orchestrate structure-preserving drawing restoration
plan: Separate protected layers and verify labels from web and published references.
Measure local blur and generate heatmaps.
Restore only accepted weak regions with conservative candidates and guardrails.
Apply optional background-only grain and recompose.
Produce QA evidence and print exports.
